summary_en: FY12/26 year-end dividend forecast raised from ¥71/share to ¥151/share, including ¥80 commemorative dividend. Total annual dividend now ¥181/share (prior ¥101). Commemorates 80th founding anniversary of predecessor entities. Part of new ¥180B multi-year shareholder return program targeting self-capital optimization and ROE targets. Subject to shareholder approval at 2027 AGM.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Increased Dividend via Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: UNISOL Holdings Corporation announced on 9 July 2026 a revision to its FY12/26 dividend forecast. The year-end dividend per share has been increased from ¥71 to ¥151, a raise of ¥80 per share comprising a commemorative dividend. Total annual dividend for FY12/26 is now ¥181 per share, compared to the prior forecast of ¥101 per share and matching the FY12/25 actual dividend. The company is implementing this increase as part of a broader ¥180 billion multi-year shareholder return program embedded in its new medium-term management plan "UNISOL II" (covering FY12/27–12/29), which aims to optimize self-capital levels and achieve ROE targets. The commemorative dividend recognizes the 80th founding anniversaries of Furusato Kogyo K.K. and Maruka Co., Ltd. (now UNISOL K.K.), the predecessor entities that merged to form the company. The increase was approved by the board on 9 July 2026 and is subject to formal approval at the 2027 annual shareholders' meeting.
